"st joseph's parish limerick” message from fr. derek i would like to say a very big “thank you ” to everyone for your kindness and generosity around my 30th anniversary of priesthood. thanks to all the volunteers who organized the refreshment in the parish hall and all who came to celebrate with me. it is deeply appreciated. fr. derek world mission sunday- 18th october 2026 world mission sunday is the holy father’s annual worldwide celebration of prayer, solidarity and support for the church’s missionary life. it invites catholics everywhere to participate in the church’s global mission, through prayer and financial support for mission dioceses most in need. the day reminds catholics that the church is missionary by nature. mission is not limited to priests, religious, sisters, or missionaries serving abroad. every baptised person shares responsibility for proclaiming the gospel and sup porting the growth of the church throughout the world. the annual collection is important 1,130 dioceses in mission territories cannot sustain themselves financially. yet the day is fundamentally spiritual before it is financial. recent popes have repeatedly emphasised that mission begins with prayer, witness and communion. there are many vocations in mission dioceses. but when they are ordained, many mission bishops really strugg le to support their priests. bereavement information
